# Independent LUKS compatibility corpus

`compatibility.json` contains 127 LUKS1 containers, three LUKS2 containers and
12 sector vectors. These are synthetic public test data generated by this
repository; no real evidence or bytes from libluksde/cryptsetup images are used.
They follow this vendored crate's Apache-2.0 license.

Generator: `scripts/make-luks-compatibility-fixtures.py` at the repository root.
Generation dependencies used: PyCryptodome 3.23.0, cryptography 48.0.0
(OpenSSL AES-XTS), pyserpent 1.2.0 and Python 3.10's hashlib/PBKDF2.
The Rust decoder, AF implementation and RustCrypto encryption functions are
not used by the generator. Python dependencies are needed only to regenerate;
the normal test suite reads the committed corpus without them.

Run from the repository root:

```text
python scripts/make-luks-compatibility-fixtures.py
just test-luks
```

Public password: UTF-8 `LovelyCarve-密码`. Volume keys are the byte sequence
`00 01 02 ...` to the specified length. Plaintext byte at offset `i` is
`(i * 17 + 7) mod 256`, for 1536 bytes; sector vectors use its first 1024 bytes.
LUKS1 has two active slots: slot 0 uses another password, slot 1 the correct
password. Seven AF stripes exercise partial digest blocks and sector padding.
LUKS2 samples use a different area key size/cipher from the payload master key.
Sector-vector IV bases are `2^32 + 7`, to distinguish plain from plain64 and
the 8-byte/16-byte block-size benbi steps.

SHA-256 of the UTF-8 JSON with LF newlines:

`52169bc25b6b5bba3c258da4cc952bd6f9132abf6b6d6846e1ab6b126489ab06`

The generator writes UTF-8 with LF newlines explicitly on every platform.
Update the hash when intentionally changing the corpus. External cryptsetup oracle fixtures in the neighboring tests are
separate and remain environment-gated.
